elements.description:
Drop a CSV, TSV or Excel file and see what was read: rows and columns found, the delimiter, the header row, a
preview with each column's type in words, problems in words, and Continue.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quiet line under the heading – what the rows will become

properties.name: file
properties.description: The file being read – the value. Choosing or dropping one changes it unless a tc-file-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: headerRow
properties.description: Whether the first row holds the column names. Changed by its checkbox unless a tc-header-row-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: accept
properties.description: The file types the picker offers, as for an input's accept

properties.name: parse
properties.description: The page's reader for files the element can't read itself (Excel): resolves to the rows as arrays of strings

properties.name: previewRows
properties.description: How many rows the preview shows

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultFileImportLabels

properties.name: parsed
properties.description: What was read: the columns, the data rows and the problems – null until a file is read

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-file-change
events.description: A file was chosen or dropped, or removed ({ file }: FileImportFileChange); cancelable – prevented, `file` stays as it was

events.name: tc-header-row-change
events.description: "First row is headers" was switched ({ headerRow }: FileImportHeaderRowChange); cancelable – prevented, `headerRow` stays as it was

events.name: tc-parsed
events.description: The file was read ({ columns, rows, problems, delimiter }: FileImportResult)

events.name: tc-continue
events.description: Continue was pressed with rows to import ({ columns, rows, problems, delimiter }: FileImportResult)

functions.name: parseDelimited
functions.description: Splits delimited text into rows of fields (RFC 4180): quoted fields, "" inside quotes, line breaks in quotes, CRLF

functions.name: sniffDelimiter
functions.description: The delimiter that splits the first lines into the most columns, most consistently; comma when nothing does

functions.name: guessColumnType
functions.description: What a column's values look like: empty when all are blank, else the one type every filled value fits, else text

functions.name: readGrid
functions.description: Reads the grid into columns, data rows and problems, given whether its first row is the header

props.name: file
props.description: The file being read. Controlled when defined (null for none) – pass back what onFileChange reports

props.name: onFileChange
props.description: A file was chosen or dropped, or removed

props.name: headerRow
props.description: Whether the first row is the header row. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultHeaderRow
props.description: The starting header-row choice when uncontrolled

props.name: onParsed
props.description: The file was read: the columns, the data rows and the problems

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Continue was pressed with rows to import

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
